title: Kīhei water main break damage settlements
summary: The County is settling claims for home damage caused by water main breaks, including one for $13,593.87 over a break at a Kīhei property. A county attorney said three of the claims before the committee involved flooding, and the County pays them itself because it is self-insured. The Water Department said a condition assessment of the whole water system will show where repairs or replacement are needed.
